customDescriptions.value: Open or close a gripper attached to a Universal Robots arm — use for pick-and-place operations or object manipulation tasks
Command a UR robot to move through a sequence of joint configurations — use for executing pre-planned multi-point trajectories
Read the current controller output signals from a UR robot — use for monitoring torque commands or control effort in real time
Read current joint angles and velocities from a UR robot — use for feedback in closed-loop control or state monitoring
Read the motion state of a UR robot — use for detecting motion completion, checking if the robot is moving, or triggering sequenced operations
Send a target joint configuration to a UR robot — use for commanding the robot to move to a specific joint pose
